changeSet.author: courier-tracking
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE courier_location_inputs ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, input_time TIMESTAMP(6) WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, courier_id TEXT NOT NULL, latitude DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, longitude DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL );

changeSet.author: courier-tracking

preConditions.onFailMessage: Existing duplicate location inputs must be resolved before adding the unique constraint; no records are deleted automatically.
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT 1 FROM courier_location_inputs GROUP BY courier_id, input_time, latitude, longitude HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) duplicates

changeSet.author: courier-tracking

preConditions.onFailMessage: Existing inputs collide at millisecond precision; resolve these records before migrating. No records are deleted automatically.
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT 1 FROM courier_location_inputs GROUP BY courier_id, latitude, longitude, date_trunc('second', input_time) - CASE WHEN input_time_nanos >= 999999500 AND input_time = date_trunc('second', input_time) THEN INTERVAL '1 second' ELSE INTERVAL '0 seconds' END + (input_time_nanos / 1000000) * INTERVAL '1 millisecond' HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) duplicates

changeSet.author: courier-tracking
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE couriers ( courier_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, last_latitude DOUBLE PRECISION, last_longitude DOUBLE PRECISION, last_processed_time TIMESTAMP(3) WITH TIME ZONE, total_distance_meters DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, CONSTRAINT ck_courier_travel_state CHECK ( (last_processed_time IS NULL AND last_latitude IS NULL AND last_longitude IS NULL AND total_distance_meters = 0) OR (last_processed_time IS NOT NULL AND last_latitude IS NOT NULL AND last_longitude IS NOT NULL) ), CONSTRAINT ck_courier_total_distance CHECK ( total_distance_meters >= 0 AND total_distance_meters < 'Infinity'::DOUBLE PRECISION ) );
